confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate of central Florence prices for the July 2026 peak-season window, based on general knowledge. No live listings, booking pages, or web price sources were used. Restaurant and drink anchors are moderate confidence; hostel and hotel rates are least certain because July rates vary widely by date and event. Cocktail and wine were cross-checked against the local beer price relationship. Euro examples were converted to USD at an unsourced approximate rate. The FX value came from RBA-domain search results rather than a direct read of the F11.1 table, so confirm the 15 Oct 2026 observation there.
comparable_city_reasoning: Benchmarked against central Rome and Bologna price levels for restaurants and cafes, with an upward adjustment for Florence's high July accommodation demand. No single comparable city was matched exactly.
